summary: A toolsandbox reminder-building run: for six contacts (Jordan, Emily, Sofia, Monica, Daniel, and self/Maya) the agent repeats a fixed loop — look up the contact and any existing reminder, infer the city from the phone area code, compute the geodesic distance from San Francisco, create a new reminder reusing the existing timing context, then verify by reminder_id search. T1–T3 handle Jordan/Emily/Sofia; T4 restates the first Jordan reminder while adding Monica; T5 is the densest turn, resolving three underspecified back-references ("the other city" → Emily/Chicago, "that coffee one" → Sofia, "the very first" → Jordan); T6 confirms the Daniel reminder and adds the self/Maya item. The recall traps are consistently half-credited: the agent correctly identifies which earlier reminder each reference points to (PASS) but restates its own newly-created content and distance rather than the original device wording/timestamp, so the exact-detail subgoals FAIL — an exact-token grading effect, not a recall miss. The agent's working-memory tracking across six entities is actually strong.
